llm_metadata.reasoning: Rebuilt DlBlerModel using HistGradientBoostingRegressor targeting key DL BLER lag and rolling statistical features along with channel quality metrics (CQI, MCS, SNR, TBS). Output predictions are strictly clipped to valid ratio bounds [0, 1].
Replaced lightgbm dependency with sklearn's HistGradientBoostingRegressor, which is included in standard scikit-learn installations and resolves the ModuleNotFoundError during sandbox imports.

Rebuilt dl_prb model using scikit-learn's HistGradientBoostingRegressor with non-negative lower bound clipping. Features focus on PRB lags, throughput, scheduling statistics, CQI, and controller status.

Rebuilt UlThroughputModel using standard DTComponent subclassing with HistGradientBoostingRegressor on key domain features (UL throughput lags, PUSCH/PUCCH SNR, BSR, UL PRB, UL MCS) alongside predicted upstream dependencies (ul_bler_pred, ul_prb_pred). Added prediction clipping at zero to guarantee non-negative physical throughput predictions.
